observations: Photo 0 shows a Sony PlayStation 5 console (original 'fat' model) with a disc drive and one white DualSense controller.
Photo 1 shows a similar console with one white and one black DualSense controller, plus cables.
The console in both photos is the Disc Edition, indicated by the physical disc slot.
The background in Photo 0 is a domestic setting with a wooden table and textured wall.
The background in Photo 1 is a retail or studio setting with a white table and display shelves.
Both photos feature a 'DELMARK GAMES ENTERPRISE' watermark.
The seller's text specifies '1 pad', but Photo 1 shows two controllers.

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show the original large-chassis design.
Photo 1 shows two controllers, contradicting the text claim of one.
No screen captures of the console's digital library or storage are provided.

risks.risk: The photos show the console in two completely different environments, suggesting they may not be of the same unit or are reused photos.
risks.proof: A single photo or video showing the console, the controller, and a handwritten note with the current date.
risks.if_unproven: as a used console in unknown condition

risks.risk: Digital games are often tied to a personal PSN account; if the account is not transferred, the games are inaccessible.
risks.proof: Video showing the games being played while the console is offline or on a new user profile.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or the console may be hardware-banned from PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: Video showing the console loading a disc and successfully logging into the PS Store.
risks.if_unproven: as a working console with no online or disc functionality

proof_requests: A photo of the console's 'About' screen showing the model number and system software version.
A photo of the console and controller together with a handwritten note of today's date.
Clarification on whether the black controller in Photo 1 is included in the sale.
response.reason: The item is identified as a PlayStation 5 Disc Edition. It is priced at its worst case: a single-controller unit with no games and unverified disc/online functionality, due to the lack of screen shots and conflicting photos.
